title: 第5章 请收我为徒第6章 洗髓丹
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
“叶无忧！今日，你必死！”
黑衣人大声喊道。
寂月诧异地转头看了女子一眼，心下吐槽，这名字怎么好女主角的感觉？
不知道有没有一对失踪的父母啊？
“道友，你快走吧，此事与你无关，我不想把你拖下水。”叶无忧强打起精神，把人推开。
“你们的目标是我，她们姐妹二人只是无辜路人，有什么事都冲我来！”
黑衣人不为所动，并且冷笑一声，“今日你们谁都别想走！”
“该死的！”叶无忧气血翻涌，憋不住吐出一口血水。
心中只感觉一阵无力。
她不仅逃不过这悲催的命运，而且还把其他人给连累了，她是个罪人。
寂月见状，眉头拧紧。
让开，我要开始装逼了！
“本尊以为，今日之事你们若是离开，便无任何后果，可是倘若你们硬要做些不可为之事，也别怪本尊无情！”
好羞耻，好想找个地缝钻进去，脚底应该给她扣了三室一厅出来了吧？
寂月想捂脸，但是逼都已经装了，她还是得维持下去。
系统送了她一身法衣，低阶的，仅仅只有清洁的功能。
但因为她相貌优越，再加上衣料质地飘逸，微风一吹衣摆就摆动起来。
而她面色冷凝，端的一副高人范，还真是有点唬人的感觉。
“你个小小炼气期的女人，还自称本尊？你不会真以为我们眼瞎，能把你误认为仙尊？可笑！”黑衣人觉得自己看穿了一切。

说到底，不过是想把他们唬住，让他们不战而败罢了。
见没唬住人，寂月叹了口气。
“本尊只是想给你们一条活路罢了，这么多年不杀生，这世人还以为本尊转了性。”
“还在这装？真以为我们几个是傻子吗？”
“即便本尊如今才炼气期，也足够吊打你们！”寂月眸色一冷，流光瞬间出现，一道剑光打过去，立马倒了一排的树。
她表现出来的，完全就是炼气期五层的实力。
这三个黑衣人，两个炼气期七层，一个炼气期六层，怎么看她都是没有胜算的。
叶无忧看着前方那道护着自己的身影，心下感动，却也不敢让她冒险。
“道友，我不值得，你快走啊！”
寂月头也没回地说：“你与本尊有缘，方才也承诺你一场，本尊如何能出尔反尔？看好了，接下来，会很帅！”
说罢，她提剑冲了过去。
叶无忧想过去拦，但是被寂琳给抓住了。
“姐姐，姐姐你别过去了，师父她会解决的。”
“可是……”
“姐姐，你放心好了，不会有事的。”寂琳她信的不是寂月，她信的是寂月背后的师父。
虽然她没见过。
但是既然有师父，那肯定不会眼睁睁地看着自家徒弟受到生命威胁吧？
应该……吧？
不过刚刚她也看到，自家大姐杀了一个炼气期八层的高手，所以这几个估计也能解决。
就是大姐刚刚装装的，她感觉好尴尬。

见对方妹妹都这么说了，叶无忧也只好把这份担忧放在心里。
另一边，黑衣人无所畏惧的迎了上去。

"Ye Wuyou! Today, you will die!"
The man in black shouted.
Jiyue turned her head and looked at the woman in surprise, complaining in her heart, why does this name sound like a heroine?
I wonder if there is a pair of missing parents?
"Fellow Daoist, please leave quickly. This matter has nothing to do with you. I don't want to drag you into the water." Ye Wuyou forced himself to cheer up and pushed the person away.
"Your target is me. The two sisters are just innocent passers-by. If anything happens, come at me!"
The man in black was unmoved and sneered, "No one of you can leave today!"
"Damn it!" Ye Wuyou's blood surged, and he couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood.
I just felt helpless in my heart.
Not only could she not escape this tragic fate, but she had also implicated others. She was a sinner.
Seeing this, Jiyue frowned.
Get out of the way, I'm going to start showing off!
"I think that if you leave today, there will be no consequences. But if you insist on doing something that is not allowed, don't blame me for being ruthless!"
She was so ashamed, she really wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl in. She should have held the soles of her feet for three rooms and one living room before she came out, right?
Jiyue wanted to cover her face, but she was already pretending, so she still had to keep going.
The system gave her a low-level robe, which only had the function of cleaning.
But because of her superior appearance and the elegant texture of the fabric, the hem of her clothes swayed when the breeze blew.
And her expression was cold, and she looked like an expert, which really seemed a bit bluffing.
"You are a young woman in the Qi refining stage, and you still claim to be me? Do you really think that we are blind and can mistake you for an immortal? Ridiculous!" The man in black felt that he had seen through everything.
In the final analysis, it was just an attempt to frighten them into defeating them without a fight.
Seeing that she didn't fool anyone, Jiyue sighed.
"I just want to give you a way to survive. After so many years of refraining from killing, people in this world think that I have changed my gender."
"Still pretending like this? Do you really think we are fools?"
"Even if I am only in the Qi refining stage now, I am still enough to beat you!" Jiyue's eyes turned cold, a stream of light appeared instantly, and a sword light struck, immediately knocking down a row of trees.
What she showed was completely the strength of the fifth level of Qi refining stage.
These three men in black, two at the seventh level of Qi refining stage and one at the sixth level, had no chance of winning no matter what.
Ye Wuyou looked at the figure protecting him in front of him and was moved, but he didn't dare to let her take risks.
"Fellow Taoist, I'm not worthy, please leave!"
Jiyue said without even looking back: "You are destined to me, and I just promised you a match. How can I go back on my promise? Look, next time, it will be very handsome!"
After saying that, she rushed over with her sword in hand.
Ye Wuyou wanted to stop him, but was caught by Ji Lin.
"Sister, sister, please don't go there. Master will take care of it."
"But..."
"Sister, don't worry, everything will be fine." Ji Lin didn't believe in Ji Yue, she believed in the master behind Ji Yue.
Although she has never seen it.
But since there is a master, he certainly won’t watch his apprentice’s life being threatened, right?
Should...right?
But just now she also saw that her eldest sister killed a master who was at the eighth level of Qi refining stage, so she can probably solve these problems.
The eldest sister was just pretending, she felt so embarrassed.
Seeing that the other sister said this, Ye Wuyou had no choice but to keep this worry in his heart.
On the other side, the man in black stepped forward fearlessly.
